'''Artichoke Seeds''' are a type of seed. Mature plants yield [[Artichoke]]s.

They can be purchased at [[Pierre's General Store]] starting in year 2, from the Magic Shop Boat at the [[Night Market]] on Winter 17 (starting in year 2), and occasionally from the [[Traveling Cart]]. They can also be obtained by using the [[Seed Maker]], as well as having a chance of being planted when using [[Mixed Seeds]].  Five to twenty Artichoke Seeds may occasionally be found in [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure rooms]] in the Skull Cavern. Eight to twenty Artichoke Seeds may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]] or [[Golden Mystery Box]].
